name: Local Recommendations
overview: Privacy-first personalized recommendations based on local watch history
description: Generate per-user content recommendations using TF-IDF embeddings and cosine similarity. All processing happens locally with zero tracking or cloud dependencies. Recommendations appear as virtual libraries accessible from all Jellyfin clients.

versions.changelog:
Leaving Soon diagnostics: too-young item details and unknown-type counter
- Worst-X candidates excluded by the age gate are now listed in the diagnostic log with days remaining until eligible
- Unknown media type counter added (items that pass all checks but are neither Movie nor Series) to explain library count gaps between the library total and scored totals

Leaving Soon: score-first, age-gate second
- Previously filtered by age then scored survivors; now scores all eligible items globally, selects the worst X, then age-gates — may produce fewer than X results but every flagged item is both unloved and stale
- Config page labels updated to 'Max Movie Count' / 'Max TV Count' to reflect that the count is an upper bound
- SkippedTooYoung now counts items that ranked in the worst-X but were excluded by the age gate

Remove Leaving Soon collection protection
- Box-set/collection membership no longer shields items from Leaving Soon candidacy
- Individual items are still protected if any user has them favorited or in-progress
- Removes SafeCollectionCount and SkippedSafeCollection from diagnostics

Pool watch data for Leaving Soon to eliminate redundant DB queries
- UserProfileService.BuildUserProfile now returns watch records alongside the profile
- RecommendationRefreshService aggregates per-user watch records into a watchStatus dict (latest watch date + any-favorite flag per item) as the per-user recs loop runs
- LeavingSoonService.Refresh accepts this pooled watchStatus instead of re-querying all users per item
- Removes IUserManager and IUserDataManager from LeavingSoonService; library queries for item age still use ILibraryManager
- Collection protection and alwaysSafe checks now use pooled favorites flag; age calc uses pooled latest watch date
- Net result: zero additional DB queries during the Leaving Soon pass

Improve Leaving Soon diagnostics and allow watched items
- Diagnostic log: LEAVING SOON section now shows skip-reason breakdown (profiles used, safe collections, scored counts, and per-reason skipped counts)
- Watched items can now appear in Leaving Soon; only favorited and in-progress items are protected
- Fix: TV series min-age calculation now uses most-recently-watched episode date (same fix as recommendation engine)
- Collection protection now requires a favorited or in-progress item in the collection, not just a watched one

Fix: add Leaving Soon settings to config page
- Enable Leaving Soon toggle with sub-fields that show/hide based on the toggle
- Configurable: movie count, TV count, min age days, dwell days
- Load and save all Leaving Soon settings from the Settings tab

Add Leaving Soon scoring to diagnostic log
- Leaving Soon: flag movies and TV series with the lowest max-user cosine similarity across all taste profiles
- Reuses pre-computed embeddings and user profiles from the recommendation run (no redundant computation)
- Flagged items and removal candidates printed to the diagnostic log for validation before virtual library creation
- Configurable: LeavingSoonEnabled, LeavingSoonMovieCount (25), LeavingSoonTvCount (25), LeavingSoonMinAgeDays (180), LeavingSoonDwellDays (30)
- Items protected if saved, favorited, partially watched, recently added, or in a collection with any watched item
- State persisted across runs: items dwell in Leaving Soon for LeavingSoonDwellDays before promoted to Removal Candidates

Replace rewatch boost with Recent Watch Boost
- Remove PlayCount-based rewatch boost (unreliable due to Jellyfin stop-start inflation)
- Add Recent Watch Boost: weight = decay × (1 + recentWatchBoost × decay) × favoriteBoost
- Just-watched items get 2× their decay weight by default (recentWatchBoost=1.0)
- Boost fades naturally using the existing recency half-life — no hard window cutoff
- Rewatches implicitly rewarded: re-watching resets LastPlayedDate to today, giving full boost automatically
- Optimize TV series date query: single OrderBy DatePlayed descending query instead of full episode scan

Remove play count from taste weighting + fix TV series recency + watched item features
- Play count removed as a weighting factor: Jellyfin increments it on every stop-start, making it unreliable. Recency alone handles re-watches — watching an item today resets its decay to 1.0 naturally
- Rewatch Boost setting removed (no longer applicable)
- Fix: TV series showed '0d ago' because Jellyfin stores LastPlayedDate on episodes, not on the series item — now queries the most recently watched episode for the correct date
- Diagnostic log: top watched items now show their top 3 driving features per item

Fix TV series recency in taste profile + watched item features in log
- Fix: TV series showed '0d ago' because Jellyfin stores LastPlayedDate on episodes, not on the series item — now queries the most recently watched episode for the correct date
- Diagnostic log: top watched items now show their top 3 driving features (e.g. Director: Peter Jackson, Tag: ring, Tag: dwarf)

PlayCount cap and diagnostic log readability improvements
- Add Max Play Count for Weighting setting (default: 5) to prevent stop-start events from inflating rewatch weights
- Diagnostic log: content match shown as % instead of raw cosine, rating delta (Δ) replaces opaque rating-prox score
- Diagnostic log: taste signals and top watched items normalized to relative % (top = 100%)
- Diagnostic log: zero-count exclusions suppressed, only non-zero categories shown
- Diagnostic log: score distribution shows top/mean ratio and renames σ to spread
- Diagnostic log: warm-start/cold-start labels replaced with plain-language descriptions
- Diagnostic log: rating units added (/10, /100), why line shows feature names without raw weights

Expand diagnostic log with 5 new data categories
- Feature overlap per recommendation: top 5 features driving each pick (taste × item vector)
- Top watched items by taste weight: top 10 contributors with favorite/rewatch/recency flags
- Score distribution: min/max/mean/σ across all candidates before top-N cutoff
- Vocabulary coverage: per-field % of library items that have genres/actors/directors/tags/ratings
- Cold-start details: community and critic ratings shown per recommended item
- Diagnostic log toggle (default off) added to Settings tab

List no-metadata and not-found items in diagnostic log
- Exclusion summary now shows not-found count alongside no-metadata
- Items excluded for no-metadata or not-found are listed by name under each exclusion line
- Lists are per media type (movies / TV) and only shown when non-empty

Expand diagnostic log with config snapshot, timing breakdown, exclusion summary, and top taste signals
- CONFIG section: shows all active settings for the run
- TIMING section: per-phase durations (library scan, vocabulary, embeddings, per-user)
- Exclusion summary per user: watched, in-progress, inaccessible, no-metadata counts and final candidate count
- Top taste signals: top-weighted vocabulary features driving each user's taste profile

Fix compatibility with Jellyfin 10.11.9
- Replace IUserManager.Users (removed in 10.11.9) with GetUsers() in RecommendationRefreshTask and BenchmarkTask
- Update SDK references to Jellyfin 10.11.9

Fix failing unit test in SyncRecommendations_SymlinksArtworkFromSourceFolder
- Test now correctly registers artwork paths via ImageInfos instead of relying on filesystem scanning
- No change to production code

Add recommendation diagnostic log
- After each refresh task, writes recommendation_log.txt to the plugin data folder
- Log contains: library size, vocabulary breakdown, embedding dimensions, and ranked recommendations per user with scores
- Viewable in the plugin Actions tab (Refresh Log / Download Log buttons)
- Warm-start users show cosine similarity scores; cold-start users show rating-based scores

Migrate from .strm files to filesystem symlinks (#13)
- Fixes transcoded playback on Jellyfin 10.11.7+ (GHSA-j2hf-x4q5-47j3)
- Symlinks preserve source extensions; media pipeline treats them as regular files
- Artwork symlinked from source folder (propagates custom posters automatically)
- Trailer discovery delegated to Jellyfin's native scanner
- Removed ImageSyncService and EnableImageSync/SyncBackdrops settings
- WINDOWS: requires Administrator or Developer Mode enabled for symlink creation

Filter recommendations by user library access (#10)
- Items from libraries a user cannot access are excluded from recommendations
- Applies to both personalized and cold-start recommendation paths
- Respects per-user library permissions including disabled libraries

Fix playback freeze when playing from recommendation libraries (#8)
- Never remove virtual library items from event handlers (deferred to next refresh)
- Ignore PlaybackStart/PlaybackProgress events to prevent DB write storms during playback
- Only sync play status on meaningful events (PlaybackFinished, TogglePlayed, etc.)
- Known tradeoff: partially watched items may appear in Continue Watching twice until next refresh

Bug fixes for series recommendations and playback crashes
- Fixed: Partially watched series not included in watch history, causing all users to get identical cold-start recommendations (#7)
- Fixed: Playback from recommendation libraries crashing with database failures (#8)
- Series watch history now detected at episode level instead of requiring all episodes watched
- Virtual library items no longer removed during active playback

Image sync for custom posters and backdrops
- Custom poster images are now preserved in recommendation libraries
- Copies poster.jpg and backdrop.jpg from source items to virtual folders
- Configurable: Enable/disable image sync and backdrop copying
- Fixes issue where user customizations (e.g., French posters) were lost

Decade-based temporal similarity and bug fix
- Recommendations now consider content from similar time periods
- Decade grouping (1980s, 1990s, etc.) replaces continuous year normalization
- Improves temporal relevance alongside genre/actor/director similarity
- Tested with production data: ~12 decades extracted from 970 items
- Observable impact: 24% of movie recommendations changed, 8% of TV
- Fixed: In-progress TV series no longer appear in recommendations

Series filtering fix and play status sync
- Fixed fully watched series appearing in recommendations
- Play status sync from source library when virtual items are scanned
- Rating proximity scoring feature
- Removed NFO file generation (Jellyfin doesn't read NFO for .strm files)
- Reduced debug logging noise

Fix NFO metadata parsing
- Fixed XML encoding (UTF-16 to UTF-8) so Jellyfin reads runtime correctly
- Added cast, directors, and writers to NFO files
- Added fileinfo/streamdetails for video/audio/subtitle stream selectors

NFO metadata and trailer support
- NFO files with full metadata (runtime, ratings, genres, studios, tags)
- Local trailer support via -trailer.strm files
- Movie folder structure for better metadata handling
- Fixed copy buttons on setup page
- Improved documentation

Initial beta release
- Per-user personalized recommendations for movies and TV shows
- Content-based filtering using TF-IDF embeddings
- Virtual library integration for universal client compatibility
- Configurable weighting (favorites, rewatches, recency)
- Abandoned series exclusion
- Daily scheduled updates with manual refresh option
- Complete privacy - all processing local
